description:
Run a guided brand discovery session and turn your business story into a focused, actionable strategy brief. Answer simple questions about your vision, audience, and market, then get a tailored report that includes competitor insights, positioning ideas, messaging direction, and clear next steps. Whether you’re launching a new brand or sharpening an existing one, this tool helps you move from scattered ideas to a confident plan you can share with your team, stakeholders, or creative partners. 
PS: If it requires payment use code "BRANDI" for complimentary access.

defaultPrompt: Analyze my company's brand positioning and identify opportunities to differentiate us from competitors.
Create a complete brand strategy with positioning, messaging, audience insights, and tone of voice.
Analyze my website and suggest improvements to strengthen my brand, messaging, and market positioning.
